statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
There is concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction (Z86.73)
CPT code 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry) was billed
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
The denial reason is that this specific service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
Continuous rhythm monitoring via mobile cardiac telemetry is indicated to assess for arrhythmic burden and guide anticoagulation management
